name: Inspection Request → AI Quote → Approval → Pipedrive

parameters.content:
## 1. Intake and safety gates
Validate every field, reject out-of-area jobs, block duplicate submissions, then reply 202 right away so the caller never waits on the AI.

## 2. AI drafts the scope
The AI picks service codes and quantities only and must quote evidence from the notes. Its output is validated like any untrusted input. Bad output goes to manual review, never to a customer.

## 3. Price and human approval
Prices come from the rate table in code, not from the AI. A person must click Approve (one-time token, 48h expiry) before anything reaches the CRM.

## 4. Pipedrive (idempotent)
Search for the reference before creating a deal, so a retry never makes a duplicate. Writes are not auto-retried for the same reason.
